wave.title: Bound the reconnect loop with backoff
wave.mission: The client reconnects in a hot loop when the daemon answers Timeout. Give it bounded exponential backoff with a total deadline, and a distinct error when the deadline is reached.
acceptanceCriteria: reconnect attempts back off and stop at a total deadline
the deadline failure is a named error, not a generic timeout
a test drives the loop to its deadline without sleeping in real time

wave.title: Document what the retention horizon does and does not collect
wave.mission: The retention chapter states a horizon but never says which records survive it. Write the actual rule, with the code as the source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: the chapter states which record kinds the horizon collects
every claim is traceable to a named function
the documentation flake check still passes

wave.title: Page the queue listing instead of truncating it
wave.mission: tally queue list silently stops at its internal limit. Page it, and say so when there is more.
acceptanceCriteria: the listing pages rather than truncating
a truncated result says how many rows were not shown
the existing output shape is unchanged for short listings
